claims.text: 根据2019年7月31日FOMC声明，Esther L. George 和 Eric S. Rosengren 对降息决定投了反对票。

citations.quotation: Voting against the action were Esther L. George and Eric S. Rosengren,

claims.text: 两位反对者倾向于在本次会议上维持联邦基金利率目标区间在2-1/4至2-1/2 percent不变，即反对降息。

citations.quotation: who preferred at this meeting to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 2-1/4 to 2-1/2 percent.

claims.text: 本次被反对的货币政策行动是将联邦基金利率目标区间下调至2至2-1/4 percent。

citations.quotation: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 2 to 2-1/4 percent.

counterarguments.text: 声明片段未给出反对者反对的理由，只能从'倾向于维持利率不变'推断他们不认为当时需要降息，但这属于推断而非声明原文所述理由。

citations.quotation: who preferred at this meeting to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 2-1/4 to 2-1/2 percent.

limitations: 提供的文本为部分节选，并非声明全文；无法核验其他段落内容。
节选未包含反对者投反对票的具体理由，需参考会议纪要或反对者讲话才能了解。
声明的发布日期为资料中声明的2019-07-31，未经独立核验。
资料未包含委员会成员的完整名单，仅节选显示部分投票者姓名。

facts.label: 联邦基金利率目标区间（下调后）

citation.quotation: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 2 to 2-1/4 percent.

facts.label: 反对者倾向的目标区间（维持）

citation.quotation: who preferred at this meeting to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 2-1/4 to 2-1/2 percent.
